<thought>Using the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the base peak at m/z 180.0423 corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈179.03498 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass within typical measurement error is C₁₃H₇O (monoisotopic mass 179.04969 Da, within ~15 mDa of the observed value). No additional heteroatoms are required, so the formula fits the requested CxHyOzX pattern with X empty.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H7O</final_answer>
